none: PAS FindID 972470: Roman Coin: Nummus of the House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of the House of Valentinian (364-378), Victory left, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped, pearl diademed and cuirassed right. Reverse description: Victory advancing left with wreath and palm. Reverse inscription: [SECURITAS REI] PVBLICAE. Diameter: 17.5mm, Weight: 1.69gms, die axis: 12
